checks.name: in a browser the download is the browser's, and there is no notice
the bridge is version 10 or later, with downloads.open, show and onDone
a library, a mail and a messaging download are each heard once saved: an id of 43 characters, the saved name and the kind, nothing else
every saved download carries Windows' Zone.Identifier in the internet zone, the PDF, the text file and tool.exe alike
the PDF opens in its program and shows in its folder, by its id
tool.exe is refused for its kind and never handed to Windows; it can still be shown in its folder
a PDF whose mark of the web was taken off is no longer opened
an unknown id is «gone»; a number or a path in place of an id is refused by the bridge
